title: Governed coordinate fallback
objective: Implement governed coordinate fallback as lower-ceiling authority that is never automatic: every proposal binds exact capture generation, target window, geometry, DPI, action, and coordinates, and every execution requires a fresh InputLease, one approval where applicable, one exact action, and one execution. Human physical input interrupts and revokes active synthetic input authority. Initial verbs are click, double-click, right-click, bounded scroll, and bounded Unicode text input only.

include: proposal binding to exact capture generation, target window, geometry, DPI, action, and coordinates
fresh InputLease per execution with one approval where applicable, one exact action, and one execution
human physical input interruption and revocation of synthetic authority
click, double-click, right-click, bounded scroll, and bounded Unicode text input verbs only
stale, replay, drift, interruption, and adversarial tests
exclude: automatic fallback from any structured failure
unrestricted hotkeys, arbitrary drag, free-form streams, and clipboard typing
standing input sessions and lease reuse
new MCP tools, profiles, or remote authority

authority_delta.process: None beyond the SG-000074 Deskal-supervised low-authority browser child process family.
authority_delta.network: None beyond SG-000075 governed navigation decisions for the isolated host.
authority_delta.browser: Governed coordinate proposals bound to exact capture generations only. Never automatic.
authority_delta.ui_input: Single exact synthetic actions under fresh InputLease with human interruption. No streams and no standing sessions.
authority_delta.secrets: None. Input content never carries secrets and never enters records.
authority_delta.approval: None. Executions consume existing fresh approvals; no approval minting.

invariants: one lease authorizes exactly one action exactly once
human input always wins over synthetic input

acceptance.claim: Proposals bind exact capture generation, window, geometry, DPI, action, and coordinates, proven by binding tests.
Execution requires a fresh InputLease with approval, performs one action once, and human physical input interrupts and revokes synthetic authority.
Exact-head CI, genuine TypeSafe Jev, Alibaba Open Code Review, manual review of excluded files, and zero unresolved review threads all pass.

successor_requirements.sg_000083: SG-000083 may activate only after SG-000082 closes canonically with governed coordinates as its base.

done_when: Governed coordinate fallback exists with binding, leases, interruption, and bounded verbs, proven by adversarial tests.
